preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 500 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 1000 for N in (int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: Each N is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive, representing the size of the array for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), (int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000 for x in output_line.split()) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All elements in the output arrays are positive integers in the range [1, 1000].

postconditions.expression: all(max(int(x) for x in output_line.split()) == min(max(int(x) for x in candidate.split()) for candidate in possible_arrays) for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), (int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) if (possible_arrays := [candidate for candidate in generate_possible_arrays(N) if no_even_subarray(candidate)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output array has the minimal possible maximum element among all valid arrays of length N that satisfy the no-even-subarray condition.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(all(elements.count(x) % 2 == 0 for x in elements) for elements in subarrays) for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), (int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) if (elements := [int(x) for x in output_line.split()]) and (subarrays := [elements[i:j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i + 1, N + 1)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, no subarray of the output array has all elements occurring in even frequency.
